notes: Contraction mirror of biology-replace-0001: removes the revision's original fact (insulin is produced by the pancreas). produced_by_organ is functional, so the cardinality question asks another candidate organ, the thyroid gland that the revision swapped in: 'no' before because a hormone has one organ, 'does not know' once the removed fact is gone; no separately stored 'insulin is not produced by the thyroid' is expected (to be counted). Related near reads the fact through the inverse (a new relation produces_hormone, staged). Related far is the revision's own question about where the organ lies. The two derived questions go through the organ by description and look up facts stored about the pancreas by name (position behind the stomach, digestive enzymes), neither of which mentions insulin. Type 1 diabetes, beta cells and insulinoma questions of the old version were dropped: those facts name the pancreas together with insulin and so restate the removed fact. The Chinese question names insulin in English because 胰岛素 contains the character for pancreas and would give the answer away.
